original_claims.claim: Rate CA3 recurrent model; 225 positions times 18 units = 4050 model units; periodic 75x75cm environment
r_i(t) is recurrent CA3 model-unit firing-rate state, not directly measured biological CA3 membrane dynamics
MEC s_i(t) supplies spatial Gaussian stimulus following prescribed synthetic rat route and is identical across contexts
LEC h_i supplies spatially homogeneous context-dependent activation; linear six-step square-to-circle morph imposed by experiment
Original Eq1 recurrent rate dynamics combine -r_i, nonlinearity f, recurrent gain J and Hebbian weight sum with mixture E s_i+(1-E)h_i
E=0.8 sets relative MEC/LEC contributions in stated standard configuration
M=2 contextual templates are constructed as ξ^1,ξ^2 with experimental overlap a at each positional cell group
One-shot Hebbian recurrent w_ij contains stored template outer products weighted by Gaussian place-field distance, with subtractive inhibitory offset -1/2
Spatial Gaussian recurrent scale ν=0.3L and MEC spatial input σ=0.3L; parameters are assumed simulation settings
Eq3 rectifies and divisively normalizes activity; network inhibition also acts via recurrent offset
J=0 comparator has deliberately added I=0.8 feedforward inhibition, not otherwise identical no-recurrence ablation
Orthogonal a=0 stored context activity vectors versus overlap a=12 out of 18 compared for two stored contexts
Each environment input walks each of 225 positions once under periodic boundary, waiting for model rate convergence
Rate maps, population vector correlation and distributions read out r under supplied morph sequence
Feedforward J=0 also displays rate remapping; same observation is not specific identification of recurrent memory
Recurrent overlap a12 yields graded population mean but heterogeneous position-dependent transition points and a mixture of gradual and sharp single unit curves
Orthogonal a0 yields sharp coherent morph shifts consistent with separate global-map regime
Random-context LEC and fixed/arbitrary MEC probes produce correlation-to-stored-pattern estimates and pattern completion in overlapping and orthogonal recurrent models
Increasing J strengthens spatial tuning but decreases number of stable spatial positions in no-MEC random LEC test
Reset between morph steps marginally changes overlap a12 population transition; smooth means need not arise from hysteresis
Orthogonal a0 morph exhibits strong recurrent history dependence at high J; reset eliminates population-level hysteresis
Single-unit hysteresis fraction increases with J and decreases with overlap; exact random template also affects it
Nearby positional groups' morph transitions should be more similar than distant groups in overlapping recurrent model, absent in feedforward control
Original published rat CA1/CA3 recordings are from cited prior work; present model is an explanatory simulation not new neural acquisition
STP is mentioned as a possible explanation of hysteresis but is NOT implemented as a modeled evolving synapse in P16 Eq1-3
Published source names alternative continuous/episodic attractor predecessors and experimentally unresolved mechanisms; inherited families must be evaluated separately
No original published exact Matlab implementation, random seeds or quantitative per-trial replication run was independently reconstructed for W3
Mean timestep converged under original 3e-5 threshold; forward Euler Matlab2012b original reported, not independently run
Rat location, context shapes, feedforward compensation, stored pattern overlap and replay/reset are experimental external conditions and not newly modeled cognition

distinguish.internal: Fixed w Hebb construction; dynamical r(t) recurrent feedback and current representation retrieval
distinguish.world_supplied: MEC location/trajectory and LEC context stimuli, morph order
distinguish.experiment: J and a variant assignments, model readout and inherited CA1/CA3 published recordings
distinguish.inferred: Model interpretation of population phenomena and predicted spatial transition signature; not independently validated unique mechanism

quantitative_scope: Author-paper reported figures and comparison only; no Matlab replay; preserve parameter/family adverse conditions.
